Wuthering Waves theme artwork

The Resonator artwork is from the official Wuthering Waves Wiki hosted by Kuro Games.
The artwork remains the property of its respective rights holders; it is not covered
by the application's source-code license. This application is not an official game client.
No account data is sent to the artwork source. Images are bundled locally without modification.
